title: The road behind you
prompt: The market bell sounds as you arrive. Before this road brought you to Alderheart, what life did you leave behind?
hint: Describe your character's home, former work, or a defining memory.

title: A reason to keep walking
prompt: Beyond the stalls, the Whispering Tankard glows against the dusk. What does your character hope to find in Alderheart — and why does it matter?
hint: A debt, a person, a fresh start, or something of your own.

title: What you carry
prompt: A cart creaks past, bound for the road you just travelled. Who or what would your character risk turning back for?
hint: Name a person, promise, place, or cause; you can also keep it unknown.

title: A measure of character
prompt: Imagine a hungry stranger steals bread while a guard looks away. Would your character protect the stranger, return the bread, pay the baker, or do something else — and why?
hint: This is a hypothetical: your answer defines a value, not an action you have taken.
